mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) is negative and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 4.5%, it indicates a recessionary labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 growth < 0 and UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession (defined by two consecutive quarters of negative GDP growth), the S&P 500 tends to rebound due to policy responses and oversold conditions, leading to positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 0 for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 60% of the instances when GDPC1 growth < 0 for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annual inflation rate above 3.0% (measured by CPIAUCSL growth) signals the Federal Reserve's potential for monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL growth > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO growth < 0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 710000 million dollars, it indicates a weakening consumer economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST < 1200 and RSAFS < 710000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) below 0% signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 growth < 0.
